welcome.title: Your retirement plan, on your device
welcome.subtitle: Estimate your retirement income and readiness — privately. No account, no server, your financial data never leaves this device.
welcome.privacyNote: Your financial data stays on this device.

feasibility.title: Earliest Feasible Retirement
feasibility.feasibleNow: Your current assets already cover your target retirement spending.
feasibility.bothRetire: Both of you retire together: you at {{age}}, your spouse at {{spouseAge}}.
feasibility.notFeasible: Your target retirement spending isn't reachable by age {{age}} with your current savings and contributions. Try lowering expenses, saving more, or adjusting your assumptions.
feasibility.noTarget: Enter your expected monthly retirement expenses to see how soon you could retire.

bituachLeumi.title: Bituach Leumi Old-Age Pension
bituachLeumi.ownAges: Each pension starts at its owner's own age.
bituachLeumi.spouseSupplement: Includes a {{amount}} per month supplement for a spouse without a pension, from age {{start}}.
bituachLeumi.spouseSupplementUntil: Includes a {{amount}} per month supplement for a spouse without a pension, from age {{start}} until age {{end}}, when the spouse's own pension starts.
bituachLeumi.deferral: Includes a {{percent}}% supplement for deferring past the statutory age ({{age}}).
bituachLeumi.usingOverride: Based on the amount you entered from Bituach Leumi.
bituachLeumi.excluded: The state pension is not included in your projections.
bituachLeumi.notEligible: Based on your insured years you may not qualify yet: the pension requires {{lifetime}} insured months, or {{recent}} within the last 10 years.
bituachLeumi.incomeSupplementHint: With total income below {{amount}} you may be entitled to an income supplement (means-tested; not included in this estimate).

sourceAccess.title: Access to your savings
sourceAccess.annuities: Accounts paying a monthly annuity: {{amount}} (included in your income)
sourceAccess.bridgeLimited: Until age {{age}} only part of your savings is accessible, which limits your sustainable income. If all your savings were available it would be {{income}} per month.
sourceAccess.rulesAsOf: Access rules as of {{date}}. Early-withdrawal penalties are not modeled.

tax.title: Income tax in retirement
tax.lowestYear: These figures are for the year with the lowest income after tax (age {{age}}); other years are higher.
tax.noTax: No income tax is expected on this income.
tax.perSpouse: Each spouse is taxed on their own income.
tax.includedBrackets: Pension and annuity income at the {{year}} income tax brackets, less your credit points.
tax.includedExemption: From the statutory retirement age, {{percent}}% of a pension of up to {{ceiling}} per month is exempt (the qualifying annuity exemption).
tax.includedCapitalGains: Withdrawals from an investment provident fund and other investments are taxed at {{rate}}% on the real gain only.
tax.includedExempt: State pensions and study fund withdrawals are tax-free.
tax.notIncluded: Not included: health tax and Bituach Leumi contributions, other credit points (for example for children), tax planning between spouses, and changes to the exemption after 2026.

dashboard.statusOnTrack: You're on track to meet your retirement goal.
dashboard.statusShortfall: You may need additional savings to meet your retirement goal.
dashboard.householdChartNote: The projection covers your whole household. The age axis shows your age.

gaps.title: Improve your estimate
gaps.intro: Optional details that would change your result. Your estimate already works without them.

items.retirementSpending: No expected retirement spending: the funding gap, plan status and earliest retirement age can't be worked out.
items.noSavings: No savings entered yet, so the projection starts from zero.
items.spouseMissing: You are marked as married but your spouse's age is empty, so the plan covers only you.
items.accountType: Accounts without a product type: {{count}}. They are treated as a fully accessible pension fund; set the type to apply access rules.
items.accountStatus: Accounts without a status: {{count}}. They are assumed to receive no further deposits.
items.salary: No monthly gross salary: deposits to your actively contributing accounts ({{count}}) are not projected.
items.spouseSalary: No monthly gross salary for your spouse: deposits to their actively contributing accounts ({{count}}) are not projected.
items.contributionRates: Actively contributing accounts with no contribution rates: {{count}}. No further deposits are projected for them.
items.gender: Gender is not set, so the defaults for a man apply (state pension age 67, 2.25 tax credit points).
items.spouseGender: Your spouse's gender is not set, so the defaults for a man apply (state pension age 67, 2.25 tax credit points).

dashboard.emptyBody: Complete your profile to see your personalized retirement projection.

legend.required: Needed to build your plan. You can't continue without it.
legend.recommended: Not blocking, but your result changes. A default is assumed when it is empty.
legend.reference: Saved and exported with your data, but not used in any calculation yet.

importance.legendOptional: Fields with no tag are optional refinements; a sensible default applies when they are empty.

validation.retirementAfterAge: Retirement age must be greater than your current age.
validation.spouseRetirementBeforeAge: Your spouse's retirement age can't be lower than their current age.

personal.label: Personal
personal.monthlyGrossSalaryHelper: Used to project ongoing pension and savings deposits until retirement. Leave empty to assume no further deposits.
personal.creditPointsHelper: Leave empty to use the default: 2.25 for a man, 2.75 for a woman. Used to work out the income tax on your retirement income.
personal.bituachLeumiIntro: Estimates your state old-age pension from your gender, age and insured years. It is paid from the statutory retirement age, even if you stop working earlier.
personal.bituachLeumiInclude: Include the state pension in projections
personal.bituachLeumiInsuredYearsHelper: Leave empty to assume you have been insured since age 21.
personal.bituachLeumiOverride: Monthly pension from Bituach Leumi's calculator
personal.bituachLeumiOverrideHelper: Optional. Replaces the estimate; enter the amount in today's money.
personal.spouseIntro: Enter your spouse's age to plan together. Their pension accounts and Bituach Leumi pension then join your projections, and you stop contributing and claim at your own ages. Common-law partners count as married.
personal.spouseAgeHelper: Leave empty to plan on your own.
personal.spouseRetirementAgeHelper: Household spending starts when the later of you two retires. Enter their current age if they have already stopped working.
personal.spouseMonthlyGrossSalaryHelper: Used to project their pension and savings deposits until they retire. Leave empty to assume no further deposits.
personal.spouseCreditPointsHelper: Leave empty to use the default for their gender: 2.25 for a man, 2.75 for a woman.
personal.spouseBituachLeumiIntro: Estimated from their gender, age and insured years. If your spouse has no pension of their own, you may also receive a spouse supplement.
personal.spouseBituachLeumiInclude: Include their state pension in projections
personal.spouseBituachLeumiInsuredYearsHelper: Leave empty to assume they have been insured since age 21. Enter 0 if they have never been insured.
personal.spouseBituachLeumiOverride: Spouse's monthly pension from Bituach Leumi's calculator

pensionSavings.label: Pension & Savings
pensionSavings.noAccounts: No accounts added yet. Add your pension funds, provident funds, managers insurance policies, or study funds.
pensionSavings.ownerNotCounted: Not counted — add your spouse's age
pensionSavings.removeConfirmBody: This permanently removes the account and its details from your profile.
pensionSavings.otherAssets: Other assets (cash, bonds, real estate, etc.)

fields.policyNumberHelper: As printed on your annual statement. For your own reference and cross-checking; not used in calculations.
fields.fundIdHelper: The fund's identifier on your statement, for cross-referencing it with published fund data; not used in calculations.
fields.contributionsHelper: Percent of your monthly gross salary deposited each month. Only counted while the account status is "Active — contributing". Typical pension: 6% employee, 6.5% employer, 6% severance.
fields.contributionsHelperOwner: Percent of the account owner's monthly gross salary deposited each month. Only counted while the account status is "Active — contributing". Typical pension: 6% employee, 6.5% employer, 6% severance.
fields.annuityParametersHelper: Used for pension funds and managers insurance. Enter the monthly annuity from your statement (today's money), or tick the guaranteed factor and enter the conversion factor (typically 140–215) to compute it from the balance. The annuity starts at age 60, or right away if the account is already paying an annuity.

equity.label: Equity & Investments
equity.noHoldings: No equity holdings added yet. Add employer RSUs/options, ESPP shares, or personal brokerage positions.
equity.removeConfirmBody: This permanently removes the holding and its details from your profile.

expenses.label: Expenses
expenses.retirementMonthlyHelper: Without this the plan shows your retirement income but can't tell whether it is enough.

projections.title: Projections
projections.netIncomeNote: Each bar is one year's income before tax, split into what you keep and the income tax paid.
projections.householdNote: The plan covers your whole household and ages are yours. Early and delayed scenarios move both retirement dates.

compare.title: Compare retirement ages
compare.intro: Pick any three ages at which you could retire to see how your income and savings change. Per month, in today's money.
compare.coupleNote: Your spouse's retirement moves by the same number of years as yours.
compare.noTarget: Enter your expected monthly retirement expenses (in My Data) to see how each age compares to your goal.
compare.footnote: Income after tax is the lowest year of retirement, as on the Dashboard. Savings are shown at the age the household starts drawing.

timeline.title: Retirement timeline
timeline.intro: Which sources pay for each stage of retirement, in today's money.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirmBody: This permanently deletes all profile data stored on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.importError: Couldn't import this file. Please choose a valid exported profile JSON.
